organization.name: DeepThought
organization.description: DeepThought is a paid media execution platform for small and medium businesses. Its AI engine turns a plain-language description of a promotion into a live, managed, multi-channel campaign in under 60 seconds.

pricing.summary: Per-product monthly management pricing, month to month with no contract. Starting Off (paid search, programmatic display, YouTube Performance Max) is 350 USD per month. Full funnel (search, social, video and display run as one plan) is 750 USD per month. Multi-location and enterprise is quoted custom. Managed-spend products carry a 10 to 20 percent management fee with media billed at cost in your own ad accounts.

tiers.name: Starting Off
tiers.description: Paid search, shopping and local service ads, programmatic display and retargeting, YouTube Performance Max. Unlimited campaign launches, continuous creative and bid optimization, monthly reporting.

tiers.name: Full funnel
tiers.description: Search, social, video and display run as one connected plan. Cross-channel budget reallocation, named marketing expert, CRM and POS revenue attribution, weekly reporting.

tiers.name: Multi-Location / Enterprise
tiers.description: For brands and franchise systems running many markets. Per-location campaigns and budgets, brand controls and approval flows, roll-up and per-store reporting, user management by role. Quoted custom.

featureList: Idea to live campaign in under 60 seconds
30+ channels in one flow: paid search, social, connected TV, display
AI-generated creative, copy, audiences, and channel mix
Continuous post-launch optimization and creative rewrites
Local competitive intelligence and per-location performance
Integrations for creative storage, CRM, POS and booking systems
Plain-language reporting on a chosen schedule
Named marketing expert on every account
Campaigns run in your own ad accounts with media billed at cost

faq.q: How fast can I launch a campaign?
faq.a: Under 60 seconds from prompt to live. Connect your ad accounts once; after that every campaign is a single description away.

faq.q: What kinds of businesses use DeepThought?
faq.a: Small and medium businesses running their own paid media - services, retail, healthcare, home services - from one location to a few dozen.

faq.q: Does Deep Thought manage campaigns after launch?
faq.a: Yes. Optimization, budget reallocation, creative refreshes, and reporting continue for as long as the campaign runs. You approve the direction; it does the work.
No. Month to month, published pricing, cancel any time. Your ad accounts and creative stay yours.
